zh.name: 罗必良
zh.title: 教授、博士生导师
zh.dept: 中国农业大学 土地科学与技术学院
zh.bio: 罗必良，中国农业大学教授、博士生导师。主要从事农业经济、土地制度、乡村治理等领域研究，长期聚焦农地流转、耕地保护、农业规模化经营等问题，主持多项国家级科研项目，在国内外重要期刊发表系列学术论文，担任多个学术期刊编委。

en.name: Biliang Luo
en.title: Professor, PhD Supervisor
en.dept: College of Land Science and Technology, China Agricultural University
en.bio: Biliang Luo is a professor and PhD supervisor at China Agricultural University. His research focuses on agricultural economics, land institutions and rural governance. He has long been committed to farmland transfer, cultivated land protection and agricultural scale management. He presided over many national research projects and published a large number of papers in top journals. He serves as editorial board member for several academic journals.

join.zh: 本课题组常年招收博士、硕士研究生，欢迎具有农业经济、土地资源管理、发展经济学背景的同学联系报考。请发送个人简历、研究兴趣至邮箱。
join.en: We recruit PhD and master students every year. Candidates with background in agricultural economics, land management and development economics are welcome. Please send your CV and research statement to the email.
